snippet.title: Set in a darkly humorous wasteland, Zombies Hate to Die First Look!
snippet.description:
Set in a darkly humorous wasteland, this roguelite offers endless variety.Experience hack & slash combat with physics-driven knockback! Scavenge, make tough choices, and master weapon-item synergies. Absurd props & hilarious tombstones make every run a riot!
Zombies Hate to Die on Steam!
